Richa Malhotra ,M.Tech, B.Tech Payments & Financial Crime SME | Senior Business Analyst |Certified Scrum Master

richa.vlsi@gmail.com

+91 9860522245

Pune, India

CAREER HIGHLIGHTS

Payments and Financial Crime Technology Professional with 12+ years of expertise in requirement elicitation for customer-centric Payment Products and Platforms based on API/Microservice banking architecture.

Have led the development, maintenance and testing of scalable, secure, and resilient payment systems in payment platforms and financial messaging, including ACH / NACHA,Real-Time Payments ,SWIFT MT / ISO 20022 MX, Cross-Border Payments, SEPA, SEPA Instant.

Hands-on experience working with financial crime technology platforms including LexisNexis Fircosoft, supporting sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and regulatory control implementation across payment ecosystems.

Collaborated with cross-functional and culturally diverse technology teams across Europe, North America, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

Partnered with business teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Payments & Messaging: ACH / NACHA,Real-Time Payments ,SWIFT MT / ISO 20022 MX, Cross-Border Payments, SEPA, SEPA Instant

Financial Crime Technology: Fircosoft (LexisNexis), Sanctions Screening, AML Transaction Monitoring (Real time and batch screening)

Architecture & Integration: Payment Hubs, API & Message Queues (IBM MQ, Kafka), System Integration

Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, MS Visio, HP ALM, SharePoint, Visio, MS Office (Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, and Word), ServiceNow.

Technology: C++, Java, Unix Shell, Linux/Windows, Github

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Business Analyst For Key Bank , Pune at Go Live Faster, July 2025- Till Date, Pune

Commercial Banking Wire, Real time payment and Internal Transfer Application Migration

Provided program-level advisory for commercial banking payments transformation, legacy platforms to Bottomline payment systems for supporting migration from cross-border wires, real-time payments, and internal book transfers, aligned with modern banking architecture and operational resilience requirements.

Led requirements scoping and configuration workshops with business, product, and technology stakeholders to define target-state capabilities for enterprise payment processing platforms.

Reviewed end-to-end migration plans to identify delivery risks across build, testing, data migration, and cutover; strengthened SIT/UAT/regression governance and defined phased customer migration strategy to ensure operational readiness and minimal disruption.

Sr. Business Analyst For Bank of Nova Scotia(Scotia Bank) ,Toronto at Avant Tech, Apr 2024- Apr 2025

US Cash Management

Supported rollout of a new US Cash Management offering for commercial clients, including enhanced ACH capabilities (Same Day ACH), modern core banking integration, and improved user interface.

Elicited and documented business and functional requirements across ACH payment flows, user journeys, and core banking integrations, ensuring alignment with NACHA guidelines and regulatory controls.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define process flows, validate test scenarios (SIT/UAT), and support go-live readiness, ensuring a seamless customer experience and compliance.

Sr Business Analyst For Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC), Toronto ,Jan 2020- Apr 2024, Canada

Real Time Rail (RTR)

Contributed to a bank-wide transformation initiative aligned with Payments Canada’s multi-phase modernization program, focused on enabling real-time settlement of Interac payments between participating Financial Institutions.

Assessed impacts across payment hubs and interfaces, to support seamless integration with non-stop funds transfer systems operated by Payments Canada.

Conducted detailed end-to-end payment flow analysis to identify changes required across upstream/downstream systems, message formats (e.g., ISO 20022), routing logic, and compliance checkpoints.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams including Product, Fraud, AML, Treasury, Operations, and multiple Technology vendors, gathering and refining business and technical requirements.

Worked in an Agile delivery model, leading requirements workshops, managing product backlogs.

Payments Transformation & ISO 20022 Migration

Drove ISO 20022 transformation program, leading MT → MX migration across payments and cash management domains, ensuring regulatory compliance and future-ready architecture

Delivered end-to-end gap analysis and data mapping strategy for PACS and CAMT messages, enabling seamless interoperability with global payment networks

Enabled enhanced sanctions screening coverage by extending controls to new payment engines and workflows aligned with ISO 20022 data structures

Redesigned business rule engine and filters to support structured, enriched MX data while maintaining backward compatibility with MT formats

2

Automation of BIC code and weak aliases enhancement process

Led the design and implementation of automation for BIC code and weak alias enhancement processes within the sanctions screening platform, replacing manual list management workflows and screening effectiveness for cross-border payments and correspondent banking transactions.

Conducted end-to-end analysis of existing sanctions list management and vendor data ingestion processes, documenting current-state workflows, scheduling dependencies, and control gaps across multiple financial crime systems.

Architected and delivered an automated BIC enrichment and weak alias enhancement framework, strengthening sanctions screening coverage and ensuring alignment with global financial crime regulatory frameworks including EU AML directives and international sanctions requirements.

AML Screening Integration (T360 Platform)

Designed real-time integration between T360 and AML systems, including interface agreements, transaction formats, and FSM-based adjudication model

Led requirements workshops, strengthened UAT governance, and supported Tier-1 platform upgrade from Oracle Database 11g to new Oracle infrastructure, including legacy database decommissioning

Associate Consultant at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Till Dec 2019

Application Migration & Cloud Readiness Program ● Managed Agile delivery of application migration from legacy environments to RHEL and WebSphere for multiple banking systems.

Worked with Product Management to estimate features, align sprint plans with release objectives, and report execution health to leadership.

Contributed to enterprise-wide cloud migration initiative, supporting the transition of payments and card processing applications from legacy systems to cloud-based platforms, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption during client disengagement.

Supported migration of European payment capabilities, including SEPA Credit Transfer flows, by analyzing existing integrations, file formats, and connectivity with banking partners such as Citibank, and enabling seamless transition to cloud infrastructure.

3
